verdict.rationale: Lifecycle Workflows (LCW) is a documented, first-party no-code capability that runs automated processes against users as they move through hire, role-change, and departure phases, complemented by app provisioning (SCIM) to automatically add/remove access in downstream SaaS apps as part of that choreography. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of the no-code workflow builder experience and specifics on role-change (mover) triggers beyond joiner/leaver framing.
